strings.Der Ratgeber für Handy, PC und Zuhause: The guide for cell phones, PCs and home
strings.Was wir von der Ameise lernen: What we learn from the ant
strings.Die Ameise legt Vorräte an, bevor der Wi: The ant stores up supplies before winter comes. Digitally, this means backing up photos, organizing passwords and printing out emergency codes as long as everything is working, not just when the cell phone is gone.
strings.Ameisen finden ihren Weg, weil sie ihn k: Ants find their way because they know it. Anyone who knows what real messages from the bank, parcel service or family look like will recognize a fake before they click.
strings.Die Ameise braucht niemanden, der sie an: The ant doesn't need anyone to drive it. You don't need a technician for most problems: With clear instructions, you can set up devices yourself and stay in control.
